Red Flags to Identify

  • Authentication failures: SPF=fail, DKIM=fail, DMARC=fail in headers
  • Domain mismatches: From address differs from Reply-To or link domains
  • Suspicious URLs: Typosquatting, suspicious TLDs, URL shorteners
  • Urgency language: Threats of account suspension, immediate action required
  • Generic greetings: "Dear Customer" instead of your actual name
  • Unexpected attachments: Files you weren't expecting from the sender
  • Grammar/spelling errors: Professional companies proofread their emails
